answer: A fresh mask is the attacker's cheapest weapon — so make cheapness worthless. Weight each identity's payout on verified tenure: rewards ramp only after many epochs of continuous, attested participation. A sybil farmer spinning fifty newborns gets fifty near-zero weights; aging them all through the ridge of real epochs costs wall-clock time no script can compress. Tenure cannot be lent — a relic of someone else's history never transfers. The honest thread of a long-lived identity compounds; the freshly minted crowd starves before harvest.
